hero.title: GravinGo
hero.subtitle: Master Gravity. Beat the Impossible.
hero.description: Defy gravity in a futuristic endless runner. Three control modes, dynamic difficulty that never stops scaling, and global leaderboards — all in one beautifully crafted mobile experience.

features.section_subtitle: Everything you need for the ultimate gravity-defying experience.

items.title: Dynamic Difficulty
items.desc: A Danger Meter that never caps. The longer you survive, the more intense it gets.

items.title: Three Control Modes
items.desc: Flip, Teleport, or Drag — each mode offers a completely different challenge.

items.title: Global Leaderboard
items.desc: Compete against players worldwide. Climb the ranks and prove your skills.

items.title: Daily Challenges
items.desc: New challenges every day. Complete them to earn exclusive rewards.

items.title: Unlock Skins
items.desc: Customize your orb with stunning skins, trails, and background effects.

items.title: Premium Effects
items.desc: Legendary and Mythic rarity items with jaw-dropping visual effects.

items.title: Key Continue System
items.desc: Use keys to continue your run. Strategic cost scaling keeps every decision meaningful.

items.title: Achievements
items.desc: Unlock achievements as you master the game. Track your progress and milestones.

modes.section_subtitle: Three ways to play. One goal: survive.

items.title: Flip
items.desc: Tap to reverse gravity. Simple to learn, impossible to master.

items.title: Teleport
items.desc: Instant position switch. Millisecond reactions required.

items.title: Drag
items.desc: Full control with your finger. Maximum freedom, maximum danger.

download.section_subtitle: Available on iOS and Android. Free to play.
download.note: Free to play · No ads in gameplay · Premium cosmetics available

items.a: Yes! GravinGo is completely free to download and play. You can purchase cosmetic items and key packs optionally.
Yes, the core gameplay works offline. Leaderboards and daily challenges require an internet connection.
Keys let you continue your run after a crash. The cost doubles each time you continue in a single run, making strategic use essential.
Every day, new challenges are generated with unique objectives. Complete them to earn coins, keys, and exclusive rewards.
GravinGo is available on both iOS and Android devices.
